title: A Tiny Autograd Engine
learning_objectives: Represent a computation as a graph of Value objects
Give each operation a local backward rule from the chain rule
Run backpropagation in reverse topological order and accumulate gradients
hints: Copy the `__add__` pattern for `__mul__`: the local derivatives are `other.data` and `self.data`.
`__neg__` can return `self * -1`, `__sub__` can return `self + (-other)`; `__radd__` returns `self + other` and `__rsub__` returns `other + (-self)`.
Topological order: a recursive `build(v)` that visits `v._prev` first, then appends `v`; skip nodes already in a `visited` set.

failure_feedback.advice: Implement `__mul__` with local derivatives `other.data` and `self.data`, and a working `backward`.
Use `+=` in every backward closure so reused values collect all contributions.
Add `__radd__`, `__rmul__`, `__sub__` and `__rsub__`, wrapping numbers in Value.
tanh's derivative is `1 - t**2`; exp's derivative is its own output.
Visit nodes in reverse topological order so each gradient is complete before it is pushed further.
